messages:
Mike R: Heads up — spotted weird quota attribution in the console. Request from a delegated service account routed to project-A, but usage got billed to the org root key. Anyone else seeing this?
Sophia: Yup, saw a couple reports this morning. Seems to happen when routing falls back to the org default pool. Billing pipeline appears to pick up the original auth principal instead of the effective project.
Raj: Is this during token-exchange? IIRC we add effective_project after the proxy routes. If the proxy makes routing decisions earlier, telemetry will show the wrong project.
Jess: Can you share repro steps?
Mike R: Repro: create SA in project-A, call /v1/complete with delegated token (exchange flow). Header set: `Authorization: Bearer <delegated>`. Routing picks model-small fallback to org pool. Console shows project as `org-root` and quota deducted from org commit.
Sophia: Root cause looks like ordering: auth-exchange runs after the routing decision. Proxy uses `auth_context.principal` at route-time. If exchange updates `effective_project` later, telemetry and billing miss it. Quick fix options: move token-exchange earlier OR propagate an explicit `X-Effective-Project` header once exchange finishes.
Raj: If we add a header, we must also update the billing lookup to read that header before tokendb origin. Also update the ingestion pipeline — `cost-ingest` expects `org_id`+`project_id` fields.
Jess: Proposal: 1) Add `X-Effective-Project` at the auth layer immediately after exchange. 2) Make billing lookup prefer that header. 3) Add unit + e2e tests and canary rollout on Dedicated. Rolling plan?
Mike R: Rolling plan suggestion: canary on dedicated us-west-2 for 48h with 10% sampling. Ship a feature flag `auth.use_effective_project` default OFF. After 48h, flip in stages and verify cost telemetry.
Sophia: One more: currently when token-exchange fails we silently fall back to org-root attribution. That causes billing surprises. I think we should surface a 401 for failed exchange rather than silently attributing to org.
Raj: Agreed on principle but it's a breaking change. Let's do an incremental approach: emit a metric `auth.delegation.mismatch` and surface it on the quota dashboard for 2 weeks. After customers are notified, change to 401 behavior behind a flag.
Jess: :thumbsup: I'll draft the middleware PR to reorder exchange -> header injection -> routing, plus metrics. Can we get Product to add a tooltip explaining "Effective project" in the cost UI and a banner for affected customers? @Product Ops
Product Ops: Can do. We'll add a tooltip and a banner, and prepare a short customer note outlining the change and recommended actions (rotate tokens if needed).
Mike R: Thanks all. Jess, please include the repro script in the PR and add the e2e to auth-proxy CI. Mark this for next sprint planning and assign owners.
